description: Read a document as {title, published_at, content}. Text extraction defaults to true. Set text=false to save PDF documents and return {stored_file, format, mime_type}; non-PDF documents still return JSON. Get document IDs from get_documents.

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

id.description: Document ID in format type:uniqueidentifier (e.g., transcripts:2133670 or report:2048334-36ccace7a771cb10e19ed97b7d474ca3)

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

text.description: Extract document text (default: true). Set false to save PDF bytes to output_file or output_dir.

name: get_document
